checkpoint_export: Byte-for-byte copy; all network, Adam, configuration and controller values retained. Its historical format-1 method identifier is rnd_error_q.
record_export: Evaluation numbers and per-episode records are preserved. Evaluation files were grouped by protocol; segment labels were added to epoch and monitoring records. Absolute local paths and launch/process bookkeeping were omitted. Monitoring retains summaries and controller decisions. Original recorded configurations are retained in training_lineage.json.
checkpoint_model_digest_format: SHA-256 over lexicographically sorted state_dict entries: parameter name bytes, str((torch dtype, shape tuple)) bytes, then contiguous CPU NumPy tensor bytes.
